title: AI Agents May Always Fall for Prompt Injections
abstract: arXiv:2605.17634v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Prompt injection is the most critical vulnerability in deployed AI agents. Despite recent progress, we show that the prevailing defense paradigm (data-instruction separation) both fails to detect attacks that operate through contextual manipulation and degrades contextually appropriate behavior. We then recast prompt injection via the lens of Contextual Integrity (CI), a privacy theory that judges information flow compliance with contextual norms. This explains types of attacks that current defenses attempt to patch and predict advanced ones future agents will face. We develop unique benign and attack scenarios that force an agent to violate the norms by (1) misrepresenting the flow, (2) manipulating norms, or (3) mixing multiple flows. This reframing suggests an impossibility argument: an adversary can always construct a context under which a blocked flow appears legitimate, or a defender who tightens norms will block genuinel

translated_title: AI智能体可能永远无法抵御提示注入攻击
translated_abstract: 提示注入是已部署AI智能体中最关键的安全漏洞。尽管近期取得了一些进展，我们证明主流防御范式（数据-指令分离）既无法检测通过上下文操纵实施的攻击，又会损害符合上下文的合理行为。随后，我们通过上下文完整性这一隐私理论视角重新审视提示注入，该理论用于判断信息流是否符合上下文规范。这一重新框架化解释了当前防御试图修补的攻击类型，并预测了未来智能体将面临的高级攻击。我们开发了独特的良性场景与攻击场景，迫使智能体通过以下三种方式违反规范：（1）歪曲信息流，（2）操纵规范，或（3）混合多个信息流。这一重新阐释引出了一个不可能性论证：攻击者总能构造出一个使被阻止的信息流显得合法的上下文，而收紧规范的防御者则会阻止真正合法的信息流。
tldr: 本文借助上下文完整性理论重新定义提示注入攻击，并提出不可能性论证，证明数据-指令分离等现有防御范式注定无法彻底解决提示注入问题，因为攻击者总能构造使恶意信息流显得合法的上下文。
en_tdlr: This paper reframes prompt injection through the lens of Contextual Integrity and presents an impossibility argument showing that prevailing defenses like data-instruction separation can never fully solve the problem, since adversaries can always construct contexts that make blocked information flows appear legitimate.
